chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 305 – Han Li Forges a Temporary Alliance by Exposing a Hidden Poison
chapter_meta_description: Han Li refuses to remove the Blood Curse for free, forcing the Meng Mountain siblings to renegotiate their worth. A hidden poison adds lethal stakes to the deal.
og_title: RMJI Chapter 305 – The Price of Salvation
og_description: Han Li reveals that the captives’ information is not enough to buy their freedom—and that they are also carrying a slow-acting poison from their masters.
twitter_description: Han Li renegotiates terms with the captured siblings, exposing a hidden failsafe poison and securing temporary allies for the coming retaliation.

lore_anchors.definition: A spoken curse reinforced by a supernatural contract; breaking it can trigger pre-encoded retaliation, such as death or cultivation collapse. In RMJI, it is used as an institutional leash for controlling subordinates.
A life-sized, weapon-wielding automaton used by cultivators for perimeter defense or combat; they act on pre-set tactical protocols and have no independent will.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li just remove the Blood Curse without conditions?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he calculated that the group's information was not valuable enough to trade for their lives. By forcing a renegotiation, he secured temporary allies and ensured they owed him a measurable debt rather than a vague one.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the point of the hidden poison in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It serves as a "backup kill mechanism" from their masters—a failsafe in case the Blood Curse is broken. This reinforces the Mortal Stream principle that in this world, no binding is ever the only leash.
